text: dsh-opencode-session 是面向 DSH Web 的模型兼容插件，通过 DSH 插件 bundle 注册，并在 llm/stream 请求流程中包装当前 pi-ai Models 实例。它会为 opencode、opencode-go 及指向 opencode.ai 的模型补上会话请求头，并附带标识 DSH 的客户端请求头；已有的会话头会保留，其他模型路由不受影响。适合使用这些路由并遇到会话标识缺失问题的 DSH 用户。无需额外密钥或账号；请求会向目标模型网关发送会话标识。

dsh-opencode-session adds the required session and DSH client headers to DSH requests for opencode, opencode-go, and models hosted on opencode.ai. It hooks into llm/stream and wraps the live pi-ai model methods. Existing session headers and other routes are left unchanged. No extra key is required.
想让 DSH 调用 opencode-go 模型时自动带上会话标识。
DSH 请求 opencode.ai 的模型总提示缺少 session ID，怎么补上？
Add the required session header to my DSH requests to opencode.ai models.
dsh-opencode-session 的功能「补齐 OpenCode 请求头」：请求带有 sessionId 且目标为 OpenCode 路由时，补入会话标识和 DSH 客户端头；已有会话头优先保留。
dsh-opencode-session 的功能「接入模型请求」：插件在 llm/stream 获取当前 pi-ai Models 原型，并包装 stream 与 streamSimple，使请求交给底层方法前获得所需请求头。
dsh-opencode-session 使用前须知：目标路由的请求头会携带当前 DSH 会话标识发送到模型网关；代码在 opencode.ai 路由补入该标识。（见 lib/index.js:92-105）

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`)
plugin that fixes the **`400 MissingSessionID`** error returned by opencode.ai's
gateway (Console Go) — it sends the `x-opencode-session` header on every
`opencode` / `opencode-go` request.

dsh-opencode-session README · The problem：Since the Console Go gateway started requiring a session header, every
`opencode` / `opencode-go` model call started from dsh fails with:

```
400: {"type":"MissingSessionID","message":"Error from provider (Console Go):
Request is missing x-opencode-session and cannot be routed efficiently. Please
see https://opencode.ai/docs/go/#where-can-i-use-it"}
```

dsh-opencode-session README · The problem：The header names the conversation so the gateway can route the request to the
node holding that conversation's cache. The pi coding agent sends it from its
provider-attribution layer; the shared library dsh uses for these routes
(`@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.85.1) does not implement it yet, so the error is
specific to dsh.

This plugin restores parity.
dsh-opencode-session README · Install：```bash
dsh-opencode-session README · from GitHub (works today)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:BrackRat/dsh-opencode-session
dsh-opencode-session README · from npm (once published)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-session

dsh-opencode-session README · from a local checkout or tarball：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-opencode
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-opencode-session-0.1.0.tgz
```

Because the package declares `dsh.bundle`, `dsh plugin add` adds it to
`dsh.profile.bundles` automatically — no manual profile edit. Restart
`dsh web` afterwards.

dsh-opencode-session README · Does this fix `400 MissingSessionID` from `dsh web`?：Yes. Install the plugin and restart the dsh process that serves your UI; every
following `opencode` / `opencode-go` request carries the header and the gateway
routes it normally.
section: Does this fix `400 MissingSessionID` from `dsh web`?

text:
dsh-opencode-session README · Why does the pi coding agent work while dsh fails?：pi adds `x-opencode-session` (plus `x-opencode-client: pi`) in its own
provider-attribution layer for `opencode` / `opencode-go`. dsh reaches the same
gateway through `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, which does not implement that header
yet. This plugin supplies the missing piece inside dsh.
section: Why does the pi coding agent work while dsh fails?

text:
dsh-opencode-session README · Does it patch files, credentials, or settings?：No. It is a normal dsh plugin bundle: it installs into the profile, registers
one `llm/stream` middleware, and wraps the live pi-ai `Models` prototype in
memory. Nothing outside the dsh process is modified, and the wrapper re-installs
itself on every boot, so dsh upgrades need no action. Uninstalling removes every
trace.
section: Does it patch files, credentials, or settings?

text:
dsh-opencode-session README · Which routes and models does it cover?：`opencode`, `opencode-go`, and any model whose base URL is hosted on
`opencode.ai` — the same predicate the pi coding agent uses. Other providers
(DeepSeek official, Anthropic, OpenAI, …) are untouched.
section: Which routes and models does it cover?

text:
dsh-opencode-session README · Will it conflict with a header I configured myself?：No: an `x-opencode-session` you set on the provider or the model wins; the
plugin only fills the gap when the header is absent. Once pi-ai implements the
header itself, this plugin becomes a no-op and can be removed.

dsh-opencode-session README · Is it tested?：9 unit tests (`node --test`, zero dependencies) cover the predicate, the header
precedence rules, the prototype wrapper, and the fail-safe path, plus an
end-to-end check against a live `opencode-go` model during development.

dsh-opencode-session README · Verify：```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A 2 opencode-session-header
```

The composed tree should show the plugin entry, and a chat on an
opencode-go model should answer instead of returning `MissingSessionID`.

dsh-opencode-session README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-opencode-session
```

dsh-opencode-session README · How it works：- The plugin registers on dsh's `llm/stream` waterfall, the documented
  interception point for model calls.
- On every request it resolves the live pi-ai `Models` instance from the
  adapter about to serve that request — so it patches the exact module
  instance in play — and installs one wrapper per prototype (idempotent,
  process-lifetime).
- The wrapper injects `x-opencode-session: <session id>` and
  `x-opencode-client: dsh` into the request options for the opencode routes.
- pi-ai merges `options.headers` last in every wire protocol
  (`openai-completions`, `anthropic-messages`, `openai-responses`), so a header
  you configure explicitly always wins.
- Fail-safe: if a future dsh or pi-ai build changes the internals, the plugin
  logs a warning and steps aside; it never fails a request.

dsh-opencode-session README · Compatibility：Validated on dsh `0.1.5-rc.1` with `@earendil-works/pi-ai` `0.85.1`
(DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4 Flash on `opencode-go`, `openai-completions` protocol).
